record.question: I shall go whither I find peace.
record.explanation: Answer A: Adverbial Clause of Place. Whither answers where, so this is an adverbial clause of place (A). Independent check: “Whither I find peace” means to the place where I find peace; it is an adverbial clause of place/direction. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/whither.
